analyzed: atra ca ṣaḍaṅga yoga vyavasthā artham anukrameṇa kṛṣṇa rakta pīta harita nīla śukla varṇāḥ bhāvanīyāḥ

original: tatra bhāvanāprakarṣaprakrameṇa prathamaṃ meghasaṃchannaṃ pūrṇacandravad bhāti. tato 'pi prakarṣān māyāvad bhāti. tato 'pi prakarṣāt svapnavat prakāśate. tadanantaraṃ prakarṣaparipākāt svapnajāgraddaśayor abhedaprāpto mahāmudrāyogī sidhyati. ity utpattikramaḥ.
analyzed: tatra bhāvanā prakarṣa prakrameṇa prathamam megha saṃchannam pūrṇa candra vat bhāti tatas pi prakarṣāt māyā vat bhāti tatas pi prakarṣāt svapna vat prakāśate tad anantaram prakarṣa paripākāt svapna jāgrat daśayoḥ abheda prāptaḥ mahāmudrā yogī sidhyati iti utpatti kramaḥ

original: anyatra bolakakkolasaṃyogān mahāsukharūpi paramaviramamadhyagaṃ bodhicittaṃ jāyate yat tad eva pañcadaśakalātmakaṃ jhaṭiti pūrvoktavarṇacihnasaṃsthānapañcadaśayoginīrūpaṃ paśyet, tasya hi pañcaskandhacaturdhātuṣaḍviṣayakāyavākcittasvabhāvatvād iti gambhīrotpattikramaḥ.
analyzed: anyatra bola kakkola saṃyogāt mahā sukha rūpi parama virama madhya gam bodhi cittam jāyate yat tat eva pañcadaśa kalā ātmakam jhaṭiti pūrva ukta varṇa cihna saṃsthāna pañcadaśa yoginī rūpam paśyet tasya hi pañca skandha catur dhātu ṣaṣ viṣaya kāya vāc citta svabhāva tvāt iti gambhīra utpatti kramaḥ

original: jhagiti bījam anavalokayann eva pañcadaśayoginyātmakaṃ maṇḍalacakraṃ paśyed iti utpannakramaḥ.
analyzed: jha k iti bījam an avalokayan eva pañcadaśa yoginī ātmakam maṇḍala cakram paśyet iti utpanna kramaḥ

original: atha pariniṣpannakramaḥ. vajraśarīre khalu jñānādhiṣṭhite dvātriṃśan nāḍyo mahāsukhasthānāt sravanti. tāś ca pañcadaśa yoginya iti śarīram eva nairātmyācakrātmakam. tathā hi lalanārasane kaṇṭhād ārabhya nābhiṃ yāvad vāmetarapārśvavartinyo candrasūryākhye. nābher adhas te eva yonināḍyau lalanārasane akṣobhyarudhiravahe.
analyzed: atha pariniṣpanna kramaḥ vajra śarīre khalu jñāna adhiṣṭhite dvātriṃśat nāḍyaḥ mahā sukha sthānāt sravanti tāḥ ca pañcadaśa yoginyaḥ iti śarīram eva nairātmyācakra ātmakam tathā hi lalanā rasane kaṇṭhāt ārabhya nābhim yāvat candra sūrya ākhye nābheḥ adhas te eva yoni nāḍyau lalanā rasane akṣobhya rudhira vahe

original: avadhūtī śiraḥkaṇṭhahṛnnābhiyonimadhyasthā bodhicittāvahā. etā nāḍyo nairātmyā.
analyzed: avadhūtī śiraḥ kaṇṭha hṛd nābhi yoni madhya sthāḥ bodhi citta āvahāḥ etāḥ nāḍyaḥ nairātmyā

original: abhedyāsūkṣme śiraḥśikhāsthe yathāsaṃkhyaṃ nakhadantakeśaromalakṣaṇayugalavahe vajrā. divyā dakṣiṇakarṇe svaṅmalavahā, vāmā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe piśitavahā gaurī. vāmanīkūrmaje vāmakarṇabhrūmadhyasthe snāyvasthimālāvahe vārī. bhāvakīseke cakṣurbāhumūlasthe vṛkkahṛdayavahe ḍākinī. doṣāvatīmahāviṣte kakṣastanavartinyau cakṣuḥpittavahe pukkasī.
analyzed: abhedyā sūkṣme śiraḥ śikhā sthe yathāsaṃkhyam nakha danta keśa roma lakṣaṇa yugala vahe vajrā divyā dakṣiṇa karṇe svak mala vahā vāmā pṛṣṭhavaṃśe piśita vahā gaurī vāmanī kūrma je vāma karṇa bhrū madhya sthe snāyu asthi mālā vahe vārī bhāvakī seke cakṣuḥ bāhumūla sthe vṛkka hṛdaya vahe ḍākinī doṣāvatī mahāviṣte kakṣa stana vartinyau cakṣuḥ pitta vahe pukkasī

original: mātarāsarvaryau nābhināsāgrasthe phupphusāntramālāvahe śavarī. śītadoṣme mukhakaṇṭhasthe pārśatantūdaravahe caṇḍālī. pravaṇā hṛdaye viṣṭhāvahā, hṛṣṭavadanā liṅge sīmantamadhyagā ḍombī.
analyzed: mātarāsarvaryau nābhi nāsā agra sthe phupphusa antra mālā vahe śavarī śīta doṣme mukha kaṇṭha sthe pārśa tantu udara vahe caṇḍālī pravaṇā hṛdaye viṣṭhā vahā hṛṣṭa vadanā liṅge sīmanta madhya gā ḍombī

original: svarūpiṇīsāmānye meḍhragudayoḥ śleṣmapittavahe gaurī. hetudāyikāviyoge ūrujaṅghayoḥ śoṇitasvedavahe caurī. premaṇīsiddhe pādāṅguṣṭhapādapṛṣṭhayor medaḥkhedāśruvahe vettālī. pāvakīsumane aṅguṣṭhajānudvayasthe. tatra pūrvā kheṭavahā, aparā siṃhāṇavahā. te ime ghasmarī.
analyzed: svarūpiṇī sāmānye meḍhra gudayoḥ śleṣma pitta vahe gaurī hetu dāyikā viyoge ūru jaṅghayoḥ śoṇita sveda vahe caurī premaṇī siddhe pādāṅguṣṭha pāda pṛṣṭhayoḥ medaḥ kheda aśru vahe vettālī pāvakī sumane aṅguṣṭha jānu dvaya sthe tatra pūrvā kheṭa vahā aparā siṃhāṇa vahā te ime ghasmarī

original: hṛtkamalakarṇikāpūrvādidaleṣu yathākramaṃ trivṛttākāminīgehācaṇḍikāmāradārikāḥ. tatra prathamaṃ nāḍīdvayaṃ bhūcarī, [śeṣāḥ khecarī.] atra ca yā nāḍī yaṃ prasūte puṣṇāti gacchati vā sā tadvāhā.
analyzed: hṛd kamala karṇikā pūrva ādi daleṣu yathākramam tri vṛttā kāminī gehā caṇḍikā māradārikāḥ tatra prathamam nāḍī dvayam bhūcarī śeṣāḥ khecarī atra ca yā nāḍī yam prasūte puṣṇāti gacchati vā sā tad vāhā

original: kiṃcetāḥ kāyavākcittadharmasambhoganirmāṇatribhavasvabhāvāś catuścakreṣu śarīreṣu vyavasthitāḥ. tatra nirmāṇacakraṃ viśvavarṇaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭidalaṃ kṛṣṇaakārabījaṃ nābher adho vyavasthitam ūrdhvamukhaṃ ca. dharmacakraṃ śuklāṣṭadalakamalaṃ kṣṇāvarṇahūṁkārabījaṃ hṛddeśe vyavasthitam. kaṇṭhe sambhogacakraṃ raktaṣoḍaśadalaṃ raktapraṇavabījam.
analyzed: kiṃcetāḥ kāya vāc citta dharma sambhoga nirmāṇa tri bhava svabhāvāḥ catur cakreṣu śarīreṣu vyavasthitāḥ tatra nirmāṇa cakram viśva varṇam catuḥṣaṣṭi dalam kṛṣṇa akāra bījam nābheḥ adhas vyavasthitam ūrdhva mukham ca dharmacakram śukla aṣṭadala kamalam kṣṇā varṇa hūṃ ākāra bījam hṛd deśe vyavasthitam kaṇṭhe sambhoga cakram rakta ṣoḍaśa dalam rakta praṇava bījam

original: śirasi śukladvātriṃśaddalaṃ śuklahaṃkārabījam adhomukhaṃ kṣaratpīyūṣadhāraṃ mahāsukhacakram. atrānandakṣaṇabhedādivyavasthā gurūpadeśato bodhavyā.
analyzed: śirasi śukla dvātriṃśat dalam śukla ahaṃkāra bījam adhomukham kṣarat pīyūṣa dhāram mahā sukha cakram atra ānanda kṣaṇa bheda ādi vyavasthā guru upadeśataḥ bodhavyā

original: anābhogayuganaddhādvayavāhi bodhicittasākṣātkaraṇaṃ svābhāvikaḥ kramaḥ.
tato bhāvanākhinno nairātmyāhaṃkāram udvahan mantraṃ japet. tatrāmī sahajasiddhāḥ praṇavādyāḥ svāhāntāḥ pañcadaśasvarasvabhāvā akārādayo mantraḥ. tadyathā—oṁ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ e ai o au aṁ svāhā.
analyzed: tatas bhāvanā khinnaḥ nairātmya ahaṃkāram udvahan mantram japet tatra amī sahaja siddhāḥ praṇava ādyāḥ svāhā antāḥ pañcadaśa svara svabhāvāḥ akāra ādayaḥ mantraḥ tat yathā oṃ svāhā

original: raktanairātmyāhaṃkāram udvahan mantram imaṃ japet. tatrāyaṃ mantraḥ— oṁ a ka ca ṭa ta pa ya śa svāhā.
analyzed: rakta nairātmya ahaṃkāram udvahan mantram imam japet tatra ayam mantraḥ om a ka ca ṭa ta pa ya śa svāhā

original: oṁ akāro mukhaṃ sarvadharmāṇām ādyanutpannatvāt oṁ āḥ hūṁ phaṭ svāhā—balimantraḥ.
analyzed: om akāraḥ mukham sarva dharmāṇām ādi anutpanna tvāt om āḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā bali mantraḥ

original: oṁ āḥ hūṁ—samayādhiṣṭhānamantraḥ.
analyzed: oṃ āḥ hūṃ samaya adhiṣṭhāna mantraḥ

original: tadanantaraṃ maṇḍalacakrasākṣāddaśāyāṃ stanau hṛtvā †svābhā((ṅgānāṃ))† kakkolamadhyavarti bolaṃ kuryāt. pārśvadvayaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ vidadhyāt.
analyzed: tad anantaram maṇḍala cakra sākṣāt daśāyām stanau hṛtvā sva ābhā aṅgānām kakkola madhya varti bolam kuryāt pārśva dvayam ghaṇṭām vidadhyāt

original: [mantrayāne] śāstrasāraṃ jñātvā yatnena sadguroḥ |
analyzed: mantra yāne śāstra sāram jñātvā yatnena sat guroḥ

original: kṛpayā vihito 'smābhir nairātmyāyāḥ prakāśakaḥ ||
analyzed: kṛpayā vihitaḥ smābhiḥ nairātmyāyāḥ prakāśakaḥ

original: gahanamaṇḍalacakraviniścayo bata bhavet katham atra śarīriṇām |
analyzed: gahana maṇḍala cakra viniścayaḥ bata bhavet katham atra śarīriṇām

original: śavaranāthapadāmbujareṇubhir yadi na [rūkṣitamastakavān] bhavet ||
analyzed: śavara nātha pada ambuja reṇubhiḥ yadi na rūkṣita mastakavān bhavet

original: [abhisamayasuvistṛtau] yad āptaṃ kuśalam anena bhavet samastalokaḥ |
analyzed: abhisamaya su vistṛtau yat āptam kuśalam anena bhavet samasta lokaḥ

original: kuliśadharapadapratiṣṭhitātmā hatabhuvanatrayaduḥkhadaurmanasyaḥ ||
analyzed: kuliśa dhara pada pratiṣṭhita ātmā hata bhuvana traya duḥkha daurmanasyaḥ

original: abhisamayavi vistare yad āptam (?)
analyzed: vistare yat āptam

original: nairātmyāprakāśaḥ samāptaḥ.
analyzed: nairātmya aprakāśaḥ samāptaḥ

original: || kṛtir iyaṃ śrīmatpaṇḍitācāryāvadhūtādvayavajrapādānām iti ||
analyzed: kṛtiḥ iyam śrīmat paṇḍita ācārya avadhūta advaya vajrapādānām iti
